# Isaiah Chapter 39 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 8 verses]*

*Babylonian envoys; Hezekiah shows treasures; exile predicted; Hezekiah accepts God's word*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 39 (Envoys from Babylon) addresses babylonian envoys; hezekiah shows treasures; exile predicted; hezekiah accepts god's word. The key verse — "Everything in your palace will be carried off to Babylon" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
